title: Refactor UI Forms to C#
problem_statement: The current VB6 forms need to be refactored into C# while preserving the original behavior.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential loss of functionality and user interface inconsistencies.
suggested_approach: Use WinForms or WPF to recreate the forms in C#, ensuring all event handlers are correctly mapped.
success_criteria: All forms function as expected with no loss of original behavior.
User interface is consistent with the original VB6 application.
